录制已混入伴奏的输入，回听时默认仅播放录音。: Capture input that already includes backing and review the recording alone by default.
音乐库中还没有已分轨的歌曲，请先导入并完成分轨。: No separated songs yet. Import a song and separate its stems first.
确认后建立独立工程，音乐库中的源歌曲保持不变。: An independent project is created only after confirmation. The source song stays unchanged.
请输入 1–120 字的工程名称: Enter a project name of 1–120 characters
请选择音乐库中的源工程: Choose a source project from the music library
跟练工程需要选择已分轨的歌曲: A practice project requires a song with separated stems
删除该工程及其录音和分轨副本，音乐库源歌曲不受影响。: Delete this project, its recordings and stem copies. The source song in your library is not affected.
删除音乐库中的原曲、分轨、附件及该歌曲下的录音，已创建的跟练与创作工程不受影响。: Delete this library song, its stems, attachments and recordings. Independent practice and creation projects are not affected.
文件会移至系统回收站。: Files will be moved to the system Recycle Bin.
请先等待处理任务完成或取消，再删除项目: Wait for the active processing job to finish or cancel it before deleting a project
请先停止录音，再删除工程: Stop recording before deleting the project
项目作为一个音频分组加入，展开后可以调节内部声部。: The project is added as one audio group. Expand it to adjust individual stems.
展开音轨查看波形，播放中可随时叠录。: Expand tracks to view waveforms. Start an overdub at any playback position.
点击下方录音，或导入音频与分轨项目。: Record using the button below, or import audio and stem projects.
点击下方录音，演奏波形将在这里与总波形同步显示。: Record using the button below. Your performance waveform will appear here, aligned with the full mix.
分轨分组已变化，请重新打开工程: Audio groups have changed. Reopen the project.
只能在创作工程中添加分轨项目: Stem projects can only be added to creation projects
组内选听：只选择此分组中的声部，不影响其他音轨: Listen within this group without affecting other audio objects
